mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, display_name, phone, last_login_time FROM sys_user WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY last_login_time DESC, id ASC
SELECT user_id, username, password, phone, display_name FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (user_id, username, password, phone, display_name, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{displayName}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET enabled = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = 1
